hypothesis: Active v7 ext-family runtimes synchronously zero the complete newly allocated 1MiB extent before admitting its first I/O. Baseline point8 packer preallocation costs ~221ms/100000puts. Synchronously prepare only the required 128KiB-aligned prefix, then initialize the unused portion of that same allocated extent in a bounded background worker.
candidate: Separate the already allocated range from its prepared ready prefix. DATA and FRONTIER both check the shared ready prefix before I/O. Demand preparation can make progress itself if the background worker is delayed. Shared locking and a monotonic cursor prevent writes over DATA or FRONTIER, including large-DATA allocation-only skips. One coalesced wake/target per runtime;no allocation beyond the existing rounded demand target;no extra lookahead or spool reservation. Stop and join the worker on close/construction failure. Cache an unused-suffix initialization failure; a later demand crossing the ready boundary propagates and poisons. Preserve existing direct DATA writes,FRONTIER pwrite,fdatasync and publish order,codec/hash,allocator and RAM/nonext behavior.
